name: Workbot will list Salesforce Opportunities closing this week (Weekly Notification)
description:
1. Upon running the recipe, Workbot will search for the Opportunities not closed but are closing this week.
2. Workbot will post weekly every Monday, 9am (Pacific Time)
2. Workbot will list the top 10 Opportunities and their details in descending order of Opportunity amount.

**Notes**
- Workbot must be invited to Slack channels before it can post messages in those channels.
- Workbot will find a maximum of 10 Opportunities.

code.name: daily_task
code.parameters_schema:
[
  {
    "label": "Number of Opportunities",
    "name": "number",
    "type": "number",
    "control_type": "text",
    "optional": true,
    "default": 10,
    "hint": "maximum number of opportunities to show"
  }
]

block.name: search_sobjects_soql
block.title: Search Opportunities using SOQL query WHERE clause
block.description: Search Opportunities using SOQL query WHERE clause in Salesforce

input.query:
CloseDate = THIS_WEEK and IsClosed = false 
ORDER BY Amount DESC
